metadata.description: A critical Junction check fails in a tenant's latest run and did not fail in the previous run. Resource API version: Microsoft.SecurityInsights 2023-02-01 (stable).
Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Rule id (a GUID). Reuse it to update the rule.

properties.description: A critical Junction check fails in a tenant's latest run and did not fail in the previous run.
properties.query:
// Alert on critical checks that fail in a tenant's latest run but did not fail in its previous run.
let runs = JunctionCheck_CL
| summarize by EntraTenantId, RunId, TimeGenerated;
let latest = runs
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by EntraTenantId
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d);
let previous = runs
| join kind=inner (latest | project EntraTenantId, LatestTime = TimeGenerated) on EntraTenantId
| where TimeGenerated < LatestTime
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by EntraTenantId
| project EntraTenantId, RunId;
let previousFails = JunctionCheck_CL
| join kind=inner previous on EntraTenantId, RunId
| where Status == "fail"
| project EntraTenantId, CheckId;
JunctionCheck_CL
| join kind=inner (latest | project EntraTenantId, RunId) on EntraTenantId, RunId
| where Status == "fail" and Severity == "critical"
| join kind=leftanti previousFails on EntraTenantId, CheckId
| project TimeGenerated, EntraTenantId, Tenant = iff(isempty(TenantLabel), EntraTenantId, TenantLabel), CheckId, Pack, Severity, Tags, Summary, RunId
